label: churn100-s7-c1
resisted: Nothing structural (5 input splits, no hidden splits, no consolidation). The service-calls gate (4344) and the heavy-use hinge (14351 -> 10552) take the usage hinge 879 as their only hidden input, so they sit as own nodes of the usage_response composition rather than in leaves (a leaf cannot take another annotation's exit as an entry). Calibration gaps: the gate opens at 3 calls (+0.80 logit; model 0.150 vs empirical 0.106 churn, 530 customers), under-predicts at 4 calls (0.32 vs 0.44) and is over-confident from 6 calls (0.85-0.94 vs 0.55-0.68; 39 customers). State offsets are overstated for state:46 (-1.89 vs empirical -0.91), state:5 (-1.09 vs -0.51), state:10 (-0.63 vs -0.22) and state:49 (-0.69 vs -0.32). 5667 (state:2) is a dead unit (never active). closed_form_max_abs_err 0.038 (state_offsets, 13164 pre-activation up to 7.7) is 3-significant-figure rounding; numeric error 8.9e-16.
tool_bugs: None new. Tool calls driven from scratch Python scripts that run experiments/species_leads/xn.py per call (all logged), because the worktree-isolated Bash refuses compound shell commands. Ablations at output-term level on the original phenotype (local numpy).
summary: logit P(churn) = -1.96 + a small linear backbone over 27 inputs (all |w| <= 0.32 per SD; state offsets up to -1.9 logit) + an international-plan switch (+2.91 logit) + an always-on voicemail-plan/state:41 offset unit (-0.54, -1.04) + exact single-state offsets + usage_response, all additive in the logit. All nonlinearity is in usage_response: a usage hinge (day/evening/night minutes, never active for voicemail-plan customers, on from about 190 day minutes), a steeper second hinge for heavy users (from about 240 day minutes), and a service-calls gate (shut for 0-2 calls, opening from 3) that is closed again by usage, so service calls matter only for light users. Train AUC 0.919, accuracy 0.921. This retrained elite copy of the 10-seed churn100-s7 genome (same key 20708, generation 98) has the same three-part usage response and intl-plan switch; the weights differ slightly (e.g. intl plan +2.91 here vs +2.88).

analysis.method: local numpy forward passes on in-memory copies of the original phenotype; output-level term ablation: mean ablation = the unit's logit terms set to their train mean; linear replacement = each term replaced by its least-squares fit on the unit's raw inputs

performance_sources.conclusion: Of +0.085 above all-linear (0.8336 -> 0.9189), restoring usage_response alone recovers all of it (0.9189). Its parts alone recover less: the heavy-use hinge +0.053 (0.8870), the usage hinge's direct term +0.047 (0.8803), the service-calls gate +0.040 (0.8731); they are complementary. The international-plan switch, voicemail/state:41 unit and state units are exactly linear in their binary inputs and restore nothing. The all-linearised network (0.834) is below a refitted L2 logistic regression (0.843).

rare_category_switches.logit_effect: mean +0.25 (range -3.85..+0.43): direct +0.43, vmail_state41_unit -1.04, state_offsets +1.04, and it switches off the 1406 day-charge hinge in usage_hinge
